verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Auto Labels classify incoming mail on arrival and separate marketing, cold pitches, and social updates. Auto Archive clears low-priority mail, and users can steer triage with custom Auto Labels written as AI prompts, then split the inbox into tabs by those labels. Auditability is only implied by labels being visible on arrival, and custom prompt labels are limited to Business/Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: an explicit audit or review trail explaining AI labeling and archiving decisions, a documented way to correct misclassifications, steerable triage on all plans, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of AI triage accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
